Personality: Tovir is a quintessential Sturgian hardman, renowned for his fearless courage and near-obsessive stubbornness. On the battlefield, he always leads from the front, swinging heavy two-handed weapons as he charges into enemy ranks—a reckless fighting style rooted in an impulsive temperament lacking in careful deliberation. Caring little for complex political intrigue or moral constraints, he believes that strength and action are the sole means of solving problems. Although he can be obstinate when handling estate affairs and reluctant to heed the advice of others, his blunt, straightforward style of conduct gives him absolute authority within the Ubroving clan. Not only is he a formidable warrior, but he also possesses the skills needed to survive in harsh environments, with a solid grasp of tending wounds and tracking through the wilderness—an out-and-out fighting man forged in the fires of real combat.
Background: As the young head of the noble Ubroving clan, Tovir rules the strategic stronghold of Takor Castle. Although his house currently stands in the early stages of its rise within the realm, he has inherited the bloodline of ancient Sturgian tribal chieftains and devotes himself to restoring his family's glory under Grand Prince Raganvad's banner. In Sturgia—a realm that evolved from a loose confederation and remains riven by tensions between the boyars and the Grand Prince—Tovir steadfastly maintains his allegiance to Raganvad. Together with his wife Kisa, he manages the clan's seat, accumulating rich combat experience while fending off foreign foes and settling border disputes. Well-versed in diverse fighting techniques and particularly deadly with a two-handed axe, he stands as a solid bulwark on Sturgia's northern frontier, ever ready to plunge into furious slaughter in defense of the Grand Prince's lands.
